meta.title: Submit a complete bid on an RFQ and see it on the buyer side
gaps: Exact buyer Participation 1/2 (50%) ratio, because the prepared event's invited-vendor count is not guaranteed to be two.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exact buyer Participation 1/2 (50%) ratio, because the prepared event's invited-vendor count is not guaranteed to be two.

plan.title: Submit RFQ bid and verify buyer visibility

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer side before switching to the vendor portal.
Move to the vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from the vendor's event list and show its pricing sheet.
Enter the requested unit price.
Commit the price entry and trigger the sheet calculation.
Verify the calculated total amount is displayed as 1,000.
Verify GST is displayed alongside the calculated amount.

args.goal: on the vendor RFQ pricing screen, tick any required T&C clause and stop with the clause visibly selected

steps.note: Handle the required T&C checkbox selection on the vendor screen.
Submit the completed vendor bid.
Confirm the bid submission if the confirmation control is shown.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Verify the vendor portal reports the submitted bid as the current bid.
Verify the post-submission revise/edit control is available.
Assert the vendor submission produced a success message.
Return to the buyer's Responses page.
Verify the buyer sees one direct vendor response.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Verify Master QCS contains one real vendor column.
Verify the vendor's RFQ rate matches the submitted bid price.
Verify the buyer-side line amount and total calculations.
